issues.on_page: Other Local Receipts, General Fund column 39,377 (p4), one line with no breakdown
issues.issue: [fixed: merged back into one 19,737 line with review] Unsupported split. No page prints a breakdown of the p4 'Other Local Receipts' line. 6,697 and 13,040 are the p6 General Fund lines 1911 Other Local Licenses and 1920 Other Contributions, and they tie exactly by arithmetic: 39,377 = 6,697 + 13,040 + 12,000 (p10) + 7,640 (p11). The rule allows split_from only when the report prints the breakdown of that line, and says never to split because another schedule's lines add up to it. Fix: after taking out the 19,640 transfer, keep one item 'Other Local Receipts (General Fund column)' of 19,737 (dominant category donations/contributions, review 'broad group; detail on p6: 1911 licenses 6,697 + 1920 contributions 13,040'). The same applies to receipts[16]. The p6 lines are already in detail[6] and detail[7].

issues.on_page: no transfer or elimination printed for 19,640 on p4/p5; p10 Fund Transfer In 12,000, p11 Transfer from General Fund 7,640
issues.issue: The hidden transfer is inferred, not printed. It is well supported: p4 General column receipts 5,287,870 = p6 5,264,476 + p10 15,754 + p11 7,640, and p5 General column disbursements 5,153,882 = p6-9 spending 5,149,808 + EB 4,074, while p9 8000 Transfers (Outgoing) 112,008 = 40,908 + 71,100 only. So the 19,640 is inside Other Local Receipts 39,377 and inside the General column spending lines (which line is unknown). The contra lines (disbursements[15], detail[82]) and other financing line (detail[81]) follow the hidden-transfer rule and are marked computed/split_from/review. The arithmetic checks out.

issues.on_page: Transfers in(out): General (112,008), Activity 40,908, School Nutrition 71,100, Total '-'
issues.issue: transfers_in/out hold only the inferred 19,640, not the printed interfund transfers of 112,008 (these net to '-' in the Total column). This is defensible because the Total column shows nothing, but the scope is inconsistent. The identity is not affected, since both sides net to zero.

issues.on_page: Employee Benefit Fund: Other Support Services 4,074
issues.issue: On p5 this 4,074 sits in the General column 'Instruction' line: 2,757,409 = p7 Total Instruction 2,753,335 + 4,074. The category follows the label, but it does not match the basic statement and has no review flag (unlike the similar Cooperative line, detail[145]).

issues.on_page: Budget 10,000 printed on the Total Cash Receipts and Total Cash Disbursements lines only
issues.issue: A total-line budget was put on single line items for the Student Fee fund (detail[140], detail[141]) but not for other single-line schedules: Bond Interest Paid 900,000 (p14), QCPU Interest Paid 682,000 (p16), Employee Benefit 27,000 (p11), Activities Support Services 340,000 (p12), Cooperative Regular Instruction 70,000 (p18). The treatment is inconsistent. The amounts themselves are correct.
